title: AI Agent for Google Merchant Center: Fix Rejected Products and Rescue Your Ad Spend
body:
Are your Google Shopping campaigns frozen due to rejected products in Merchant Center?

For any e-commerce store or B2B distributor, having feed errors is a silent financial drain. Every day that Google rejects your products because of incomplete titles, poorly mapped categories, or missing mandatory attributes, you are losing customers to your competitors and wasting engineering budget on manual fixes that do not scale.

The Trap of Manual ERP Adjustments

Trying to solve these mismatches by modifying your main database or configuring rigid rules in Shopify or WooCommerce is a losing battle. Platforms take hours to update, basic rules do not understand product context, and you end up breaking your internal inventory structure. A syntax error in your data feed should never paralyze your business revenue.

Our Solution: AI Agent for Feed Cleaning and Enrichment

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we integrate a specialized AI Agent that intercepts your website's outbound feed and dynamically optimizes it before it reaches Google Merchant Center, operating in real time from the root directory.

  1. Automated semantic correction: The agent detects erroneous or empty attributes and fixes them using advanced language models.
  2. Intelligent category mapping: It automatically translates your local catalog into the official Google taxonomy without altering your database.
  3. Optimized variable injection: It rewrites titles and descriptions by including transactional keywords to boost your ad CTR.
  4. Pre-validation perimeter: It acts as a firewall that analyzes the XML or JSON file, ensuring a perfect format that prevents suspensions.

The Real Impact on Your Digital Sales

  • Zero rejected products: It guarantees the continuous approval of your entire product catalog on Google Shopping.
  • Savings on technical development: It eliminates hours spent writing custom code to adapt the feed to Google's changing policies.
  • Boosted ROAS: By displaying cleaner, optimized data, your campaigns capture leads with a much higher purchase intent.
